import TransposeFollowup.SourceEndpointsMeaning
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


def negativeMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -2; hi := -1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def zeroHiMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -1; hi := 0
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def clipPortIndex : EndpointClip.Port → Nat
  | .dimension => 0 | .index => 1 | .unit => 2 | .zero => 3 | .fuel => 4 | .scratch => 5 | .grid => 6
  | .work j => 7+j.val | .out j => 11+j.val

def portIndex : SourceEndpoints.Port → Nat
  | .shared p => clipPortIndex p | .other j => 14+j.val

def ports : List SourceEndpoints.Port :=
  ([EndpointClip.Port.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid] ++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work ++ (List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out).map
      SourceEndpoints.Port.shared ++ (List.finRange 3).map SourceEndpoints.Port.other

def heads (p : SourceEndpoints.Port) : Int := 19*(portIndex p : Int)-137

def rawEndpoint (A B : Nat) (upper negative : Bool) (m N I : Nat) : Bool × (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
  let J := (I+(if upper then 1 else 0))%2^m
  let left := (A*N)%2^m
  let right := (B*J)%2^m
  let grid := if negative then !upper else if upper then decide (right<=left) else decide (left<=right)
  let out := if grid then (J,0,N) else if negative then (0,A%2^m,B%2^m) else (A%2^m,0,B%2^m)
  let guard := if negative then !upper else if upper then decide (right<(left+B)%2^m)
    else decide (left<(right+B)%2^m)
  (guard,out)

def checkCase (A B : Bool → Nat) (negative : Bool → Bool) (n i : List Bool)
    (expectedOpen : Bool) (expectedOut : Bool → Nat × Nat × Nat) : Bool :=
  let m := n.length
  let N := Counter.value n
  let I := Counter.value i
  let J := (I+1)%2^m
  let work : Fin 4 → Nat := ![A true%2^m,B true%2^m,
    (A true*N+(if !negative true then B true else 0))%2^m,(B true*J)%2^m]
  let out (upper : Bool) : Fin 3 → Nat :=
    ![(expectedOut upper).1,(expectedOut upper).2.1,(expectedOut upper).2.2]
  let S := A false+B false+A true+B true
  let c := NativeZipper.run (SourceEndpoints.program A B negative) (208*m+523+2*S*(18*m+52))
    (SourceEndpoints.zipperCfg (.lower (.inl (.grid (.init (.erase 0))))) (SourceEndpoints.initial n i) heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done expectedOpen) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .dimension)=Counter.marked n) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .index)=Counter.marked i) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .unit)=Counter.marked (true::List.replicate (m-1) false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .zero)=Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .fuel)=Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes (.shared .grid)=Counter.marked (bits m J)) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes (.shared .scratch)).left=[.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes (.shared .scratch)).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.shared (.work j))=Counter.marked (bits m (work j)))) &&
    [false,true].all (fun upper => (List.finRange 3).all (fun j =>
      decide (c.core.tapes (if upper then .other j else .shared (.out j))=Counter.marked (bits m (out upper j))))) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut raw := 0
  let mut rational := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for seed in List.range 32 do
    let m := 1+seed%6
    let A : Bool → Nat := fun upper => if upper then (seed/3)%4 else seed%4
    let B : Bool → Nat := fun upper => if upper then 1+(seed/5)%3 else 1+(seed/7)%4
    let negative : Bool → Bool := fun upper => if upper then (seed/4)%2==0 else (seed/2)%2==0
    let N := (13*seed+1)%2^m
    let I := (7*seed+3)%2^m
    let result (upper : Bool) := rawEndpoint (A upper) (B upper) upper (negative upper) m N I
    raw := raw+1
    if !checkCase A B negative (bits m N) (bits m I) ((result false).1 && (result true).1)
      (fun upper => (result upper).2) then failures := failures+1
  for F in cases ++ [negativeMap,zeroHiMap] do
    for N in [1,2,4] do
      let xs := bits N.size N
      let nw := PaddedWord.word (PaddedWord.commonConstant F) id xs
      for i in List.finRange N do
        let expectedOpen := decide (max F.lo ((i.val : Rat)/N) < min F.hi (((i.val : Rat)+1)/N))
        let out (upper : Bool) :=
          let p := if upper then F.rightPair i else F.leftPair i
          (p.1.toNat,(-p.1).toNat,p.2.toNat)
        rational := rational+1
        if !checkCase (SourceEndpoints.magnitude F) (SourceEndpoints.denominator F) (SourceEndpoints.negative F)
            nw (bits nw.length i.val) expectedOpen out then failures := failures+1
  return (raw,rational,failures)
#eval checks
